title: Bamburi Cement breaks ground on 1.6Mt/yr Matuga cement plant
summary: Bamburi Cement breaks ground on 1.6Mt/yr Matuga cement plant
body_markdown:
**Kenya:** Amsons Group subsidiary Bamburi Cement commenced construction of its upcoming US$250m, 1.6Mt/yr Matuga cement plant in Kwale County on 24 November 2026. Capital FM News has reported that the plant will also have an additional clinker grinding capacity of 0.6Mt/yr. It will incorporate a six-stage precalciner system and substitute cashew nut shells, coconut husks and municipal solid waste as alternative fuels. When operational, it will more than double Bamburi Cement’s clinker capacity to 2.6Mt/yr and its cement capacity to 4Mt/yr.


China-based engineering firm Sinoma CBMI Construction won an engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contract to build the plant in December 2025.
